A mysterious voice, the {npc:Strange Pipe}, warns that Rathleton's old enemy, Jaccus Maxxen, is back and threatens the glooth factory and the whole city. With your team you cross {wiki:Jaccus Maxxen's Dungeon|Jaccus Maxxen's Dungeon}, switching on machines and defeating the {creature:Deep Terror}, the {creature:Glooth Horror|Glooth Horrors}, the lava room and finally {creature:Professor Maxxen}. You receive a bag with a {item:Glooth Glider Blueprint}, permanent access to the whole dungeon and its bosses, and the achievement **The Professor's Nut**.
An old enemy of Rathleton, Jaccus Maxxen, is a threat to the city.
No known minimum level, but the **recommended level is 200+**.
A **team** of a decent level: you can go with as many players as you like, but with few you will hardly get past the first rooms.
Lots of health and mana potions: there are 10 minutes per boss room and continuous waves of creatures.
Protective equipment against **energy** and/or {spell:Magic Shield} to withstand the explosions of the Glooth-Generators (5600 damage) in the final fight.
Access to the whole of {wiki:Jaccus Maxxen's Dungeon|Jaccus Maxxen's Dungeon} and the ability to kill the bosses inside
Ability to kill {creature:Raging Fire|Raging Fires} for 50 charm points
**Go with da Lava Flow** and **The Professor's Nut** achievements
All areas of Jaccus Maxxen's Dungeon

On completing the quest (after defeating {creature:Professor Maxxen}); the three {item:Magic Forcefield|Magic Forcefields} east of the first room let you skip puzzles and bosses and go straight to hunting or killing a specific boss.
You need Premium and the Squire rank in the {wiki:Rathleton Quest}.
On completing the quest: you can kill the bosses inside again using the shortcuts in the first room.
Killing Raging Fires for charm points
They give **50** charm points; they do not count before you complete the quest.

In each area there are several **Strange Machines** that all have to be switched on before the portal works. They switch off after some time: spread the team out to switch them on almost at the same time, preferably in a freshly cleared spawn.
Always talk to the **Strange Pipe** of each area before entering the portal: that is what lets you move on to the next room.
In every boss room you have a limit of **10 minutes**.
After finishing the quest you can use the shortcuts in the first room to go directly to any area (see final section).

Rathleton is on the island of **Oramond**. Since you already have the rank of Squire (above Citizen) in the {wiki:Rathleton Quest}, there is a boat to Oramond from Thais ({npc:Captain Bluebear}), Edron ({npc:Captain Seahorse}) or Venore ({npc:Captain Fearless}): say {key:hi}, {key:oramond}, {key:yes}. You disembark at {npc:Captain Gulliver}'s raft, **west** of Oramond. Enter the {item:Slime Slide}: it takes you to a mound on the main island. Go down to the ground floor and walk **east** to some buildings with a small boat; that boat's portal takes you to the other side of the water. From there go **north** to the main gate of Rathleton.
Mound where the Slime Slide drops you off
Path from the boat to Rathleton

In Rathleton, go to the Workshop Quarter, to the building just **east** of the stairs to Upper Rathleton, and enter the {item:Slime Slide} (you need at least the rank of Citizen). It takes you to the {wiki:Underground Glooth Factory|Underground Glooth Factory}. {wiki:Jaccus Maxxen's Dungeon|Jaccus Maxxen's Dungeon} is at the bottom of the factory.
Slime Slide to the Underground Glooth Factory

Go to the {wiki:Underground Glooth Factory|Underground Glooth Factory}, walk **west** and go down to the bottom of the "well". Find the {npc:Strange Pipe} on the **west** side and talk to it: {key:hi}, {key:importance}, {key:madman}, {key:laboratory}, {key:years}, {key:way}, {key:allies}, {key:guardian}, {key:plan}, {key:enraged}.

Leave the factory through the {item:Door (Sealed)|quest door} on the **east** side, on the lowest level. You enter {wiki:Jaccus Maxxen's Dungeon|Jaccus Maxxen's Dungeon}. Far to the **east** there is a {item:Magic Forcefield}.

On the way to the forcefield there are **8** {item:Strange Machine|Strange Machines}: 3 on the north side, 3 in the middle and 2 on the south side. The team has to switch them all on and enter the forcefield before they switch off. A team of 2 can do it by running through a freshly cleared spawn.
Enter the portal and survive the Glooth Anemones

With the machines on, enter the portal far to the **east**. You end up in a small room with a teleport to the east. From here you have **10 minutes** to kill all the waves **and** the boss. Wait a moment and {creature:Glooth Anemone|Glooth Anemones} start to appear: there are about 5–7 waves and the new ones appear just before you clear the previous one.
Kill the 4 tentacles at the same time

Then 4 {creature:Tentacle of the Deep Terror|Tentacles of the Deep Terror} appear. They have a lot of health and retreat when they reach about 1000–2000 health. You have to kill **all of them at the same time**: when the first one dies, there is a **10-second** window before it comes back with full health. If you kill them all within that window, the {creature:Deep Terror} appears.
Bring the four tentacles down to low health and only then kill them one after the other, within the 10 seconds.
Kill the {creature:Deep Terror} to move on.
Move on to the second room
After defeating the Deep Terror, enter the portal **east** of its room. You are taken to another large room with 8 more Strange Machines.
**First of all**, talk to the **Strange Pipe** in this room ({key:hi}) to make sure you can enter the next boss room.
Switch on the machines and enter the portal
Switch on all the Strange Machines and enter the teleport, which is far to the **west**.
When you enter, a few waves of 1 {creature:Rot Elemental}, 1 {creature:Devourer} and 1 {creature:Glooth Blob} appear.

Then a single {creature:Feeble Glooth Horror} appears. Each time you kill one, it splits into two as follows. You have to kill all the variants (within the 10 minutes) to activate the portal to the **west**.
Gathering all the Horrors at once is extremely deadly without a very large team (the Strange Pipe itself advises against it). Choose one of the strategies below.

Always kill the strongest one first, with single-target attacks. In brackets is what is left in the room after each step. If the team does not have enough single-target damage, it is kicked out at the end of the 10 minutes.
Strategy B — all at once (the usual one, but hard)
Since the safe strategy usually does not fit within 10 minutes, the most common approach is to kill each generation all at once:

Kill the first three generations at once with area attacks and, from the 8 Strong onwards, bring them all down to low health and kill **one Strong at a time** followed by the **2 Empowered** it creates. The blockers have to hold out, in the worst case, 7 Strong and 2 Empowered.
Use area attacks while the Strong have high health, keeping the Empowered away; then switch to single target.
When all the Glooth Horror variants are dead, the portal to the **west** becomes active. Enter it.
3. Into the fire — the lava room
You appear in another large room with more Strange Machines. Talk to the **Strange Pipe**, which is a little **south** of where you appear ({key:hi}).
Switch on the machines and enter the portal
Make your way to the portal far to the **west**, switch on all the Strange Machines to activate it and enter. You arrive in a large room with a small edge of lava.

After a short while the lava spreads and {creature:Raging Fire|Raging Fires} appear. Kill them and use their corpses ({item:Magma Chunk|Magma Chunks}) on the {item:Crucible}, to the **northwest**, within the time limit of each wave:
30 seconds after the 3rd wave you are teleported to the next area and gain the **Go with da Lava Flow** achievement.

The number of Raging Fires that appear is random: not enough may appear. If that happens, or if the team does not use enough corpses on the Crucible in time, everyone is sent back to the west teleport of the previous area and has to switch on all the Strange Machines of this area again.
Talk to the **Strange Pipe**, which is very close to the teleport you arrived by ({key:hi}).
Switch on the machines and enter the portal to the east
Switch on all the Strange Machines in the area and enter the portal to the **east**.

You arrive in a large square room with 4 glooth generators set away from the wall, one in each corner. A few seconds later a few waves of {creature:Glooth Golem|Glooth Golems} appear and then the final boss, {creature:Professor Maxxen}. He summons 2 {creature:Walker|Walkers} and fights alongside three accomplices (they are not summons): {creature:Glooth Masher}, {creature:Glooth Slasher} and {creature:Glooth Trasher}. During the fight he is teleported a few times to another part of the room.
The four generators turn into {creature:Glooth-Generator|Glooth-Generators} in this order:
Some time after Professor Maxxen appears

When a generator appears and a player is nearby, you hear *"THE GLOOTH GENERATOR CHARGES UP FOR A LETHAL EXPLOSION"*. 14–15 seconds later, if it is still alive, 4 {creature:Energy Pulse|Energy Pulses} appear at the generators and explode immediately (*"The fully charged generator explodes in a blast!"*), dealing **5600 energy damage** to everyone within a radius of 6 squares.

Recommended strategy: the whole team attacks the generator as soon as it appears. Even so, everyone must be prepared to reduce and absorb the damage (protective equipment against energy, {spell:Magic Shield}, etc.). The generators **do not** charge if there are no players nearby: keeping the whole team on the south side of the room is an option, but it is risky — if a player comes within range of an active generator, the Energy Pulses appear and explode immediately.
Kill {creature:Professor Maxxen} (and the accomplices) while controlling the generators.
After defeating Professor Maxxen, enter the portal to the **east** into the reward room and talk to the **Strange Pipe** ({key:hi}).

Open the {item:Box} to the **north** to receive a {item:Bag} with: {item:Glooth Glider Blueprint}, 4 {item:Glooth Bag|Glooth Bags}, 5 {item:Platinum Coin|Platinum Coins} and a {item:Walnut}. You also gain the **The Professor's Nut** achievement.
Bag with Glooth Glider Blueprint, 4 Glooth Bags, 5 Platinum Coins and Walnut + The Professor's Nut achievement

Leave through the {item:Slime Slide} to the **east**, which takes you back to Rathleton. To return to the mainland, use the Rathleton Slime Slide that leads to the boat (with the rank of Citizen) or walk the arrival route in reverse, and talk to {npc:Captain Gulliver}: {key:hi}, the name of the city (for example {key:thais}, {key:edron}, {key:venore} or {key:port hope}) and {key:yes}.
The three teleports in the first room
After finishing the quest, you can use the three {item:Magic Forcefield|Magic Forcefields} to the **east** of the first room to skip puzzles and bosses and go hunt or kill a specific boss:
Entrance of the 2nd room (after the Deep Terror)
Entrance of the 3rd room (after the Glooth Horrors)
Entrance of the 4th room (after the lava room)
The Raging Fires can only be killed for charm points (50) after you complete the quest.
To repeat a specific area (hunt or boss), use the shortcuts in section 6 instead of doing everything again.
